title: Redis: shard primary failover
description: Drives a `CLUSTER FAILOVER` on a Redis replica to flip it to primary; measures RTO; verifies the previous primary becomes a replica.

observe.what: scenario=redis-shard · original primary · new primary · RTO seconds (~0.5-2s in the lab) · timeline (5 phases)

observe.where: redis-cli on any node: CLUSTER NODES
observe.what: the originally-targeted replica now flagged 'master'; the previous primary now 'slave'
roles flipped: the replica picked above is now primary, the previous primary is now replica

whatProves: Redis Cluster gossip + CLUSTER FAILOVER produce a sub-second role flip under controlled conditions; the RedisAdapter measures + reports it via the failover-test timeline shape.
